title: The plan skill binds a decision already on the board before it derives a new one
name: decision-reuse
description: ADR 0055's aim is 'don't re-ask what the code already answers', but the planning agent cannot see answered decisions: the `board` tool renders open ones only, the `decisions` tool lists only those waiting, and `sober decisions --all` exists on the CLI alone. So every `plan` run can re-derive and re-ask the same question and leave duplicate records. Two parts. (1) The `decisions` MCP tool takes an `all` input, mirroring `sober decisions --all`: answered decisions too, each with its category, chosen option and `derived` source (packages/mcp/src/, with a render test). (2) Step 5 of plugins/skills/plan/SKILL.md: before writing a decision, call `decisions` with `all`; if one on the board already covers the question — open or answered — put its id in the node's `decisions` instead of proposing a new one; derive only when none does. Run `pnpm plugins` so all four hosts get it. No core change and no new ADR: this applies 0055, it does not change it.

brief.approach: Extend packages/mcp/src/tools/plan.ts `decisions` tool input with optional `all` (default false) and pass it to `renderDecisions` in packages/mcp/src/render.ts. Preserve the present open-only output by default; for `all`, follow packages/cli/src/work.ts `decisions(true)`: omit archived records, order open/unopened/answered by creation time, and show each answered decision's category, question, chosen option/label, answer provenance (`answer.derived`), and alternatives with their reason and later cost. Add render tests in packages/mcp/src/render.test.ts for default versus all, ordering, archived exclusion, and an answered derived decision. Update step 5 of plugins/skills/plan/SKILL.md to call `decisions` with `all` before proposing: reuse an existing open or answered decision id in relevant nodes' `decisions` lists when it covers the same question, and derive a new decision only if none matches. Run `pnpm plugins` to regenerate all host skill copies. Complexity 5/10: the tool and renderer are small, but compatibility of default output and generated plugin copies require careful verification. This implements ADR 0055 without changing core or adding an ADR.

acceptance.proves: Default and all-decision rendering preserve the open view and correctly expose answered decisions, provenance, ordering, and archive filtering.
The new MCP tool input and renderer compile against the existing board and schema types.
The edited plan skill regenerates successfully for each shipped host plugin.
